description: Suggest an action on the person's record for them to approve in the Recordist app: draft the follow-up (kind draft_followup: meeting_id, optional template_id), mark a promise done (kind mark_promise_done: action_item_id), or export a meeting (kind export_meeting: meeting_id, optional format md|txt|srt|vtt|json). Nothing runs on this call. Recordist shows a card that says exactly what will happen and waits for the person to press Approve or Not now; a suggestion nobody answers runs out. Use `reason` to say why, in one sentence; it is shown on the card in your words. Poll `action_status` for the answer. Requires the app to be running and 'Let connected assistants suggest actions' turned on in Settings → Integrations → Recordist Agent.

action_item_id.description: mark_promise_done: the promise's id from get_action_items

reason.description: Why you suggest it, in one sentence, shown to the person

template_id.description: draft_followup: the template; default the meeting's own

via.description: The assistant's name, shown on the card (for example 'Claude Desktop')

name: propose_action
title: Suggest an action
